sections: 9 HEADER VARIABLES: DIMSTYLE is an H hard pointer
authority.layoutApplied: The AC1012 DICTIONARY body uses counted entry names and soft-owner item handles; the R2000+ cloning and hard-owner fields are absent. Both drawings use NOD -> ACAD_MLINESTYLE -> SAME_KEY, with the target MLINESTYLE owned by ACAD_MLINESTYLE and the current DIMSTYLE header reference bound to Standard.

limits: The samples are locally generated, specification-directed controls, not AutoCAD-authored files.
The producer and consumer roundtrip do not establish AutoCAD normal-open behavior or native duplicate-merge semantics for the absent AC1012 cloning field.
